summary: Verified the new mobile top-bar menu redesign in /songcoder.html at 360/390/760 widths, desktop 1920 & tablet 1024, iframe embed, and What's New popup regression. All target behaviours pass: single mobile-menu-btn is placed inline at the right of the tabs (same y as .tabs), the per-icon Search/Drafts/Changes/Settings buttons are hidden in the bar (top-right visibility:hidden), tapping the menu button toggles the dropdown (visibility:visible), the 'on' class swaps the menu->X icon, and Escape + outside click + clicking any row (tested Search) close the menu. In iframe mode (page.set_content with <iframe>), the brand row is correctly hidden while the tabs+menu row remain and the menu still opens. Desktop/tablet regression: mobile-menu-btn is hidden and the original top-right action buttons remain visible. Badge data-testid=mobile-menu-count is correctly hidden when sum=0 (natural state - no drafts, no PRs). What's New: after setting treesh_mad_seen_build='old' and reloading, whats-new-modal shows exactly 4 items (count=4) with build text 'Build 2026-10-12 18:00 · v5.6'. --tbh CSS var is set to the live topbar height (127px on 390x800), so .stamp-bar / .toasts positions follow correctly (stamp-bar not visible without a loaded song so position couldn't be measured live, but the CSS rule top:calc(var(--tbh,106px) + 10px) and ResizeObserver updating --tbh were verified).
critical_code_review_comments: Badge sum logic in the mobile-menu IIFE uses el.closest('[hidden]') to skip counts whose row button is hidden - correct, but it means forcibly updating only the text (without un-hiding the parent) won't move the badge. This is by design; just noting for future tests.
Pre-existing (not part of this change): console shows CORS errors for https://treesh.app/content/whatsnew.json and /blog when running in preview. Not blocking; fallback paths work.
test_credentials: Admin passcode TreeshMAD-test-2026; icon mock token mock-chelly (not needed to validate badge/menu basics)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 covered lyric stamping/iframe brand/what's new; iteration 28 covered the mobile top-bar redesign (single menu button + dropdown + badge). All green. If retesting badge sum with real counts, create a draft via Compose (type a title then switch tab) or sign in as admin to get open PRs - then observe #menu-count. For the 'tour spotlights menu button' claim on mobile icon-mode, the tour selector fallback at line 4601 ('if top-right is hidden, use #open-menu') is implemented and visually confirmed; the welcome tour copy auto-redirects any step whose target lives inside the collapsed menu to #open-menu.
